commands.command:
set -eu
repo=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work
wt=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/macbook-trackpad-zoom
key=/Users/michal/.ssh/id_ed25519
pi=michal@192.168.0.23
printf 'MAC_BASE=%s %s\n' "$(git -C "$repo" branch --show-current)" "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'MAC_BASE_DIRTY_COUNT=%s\n' "$(git -C "$repo" status --porcelain=v1 | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
printf 'MAC_WORK_BRANCH=%s %s\n' "$(git -C "$wt" branch --show-current)" "$(git -C "$wt" rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'MAC_WORK_DIRTY_COUNT=%s\n' "$(git -C "$wt" status --porcelain=v1 | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
test -r "$key"
printf 'PI_PREFLIGHT_BEGIN\n'
ssh -i "$key" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 "$pi" '
set -eu
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
printf "PI_BRANCH=%s\n" "$(git branch --show-current)"
printf "PI_HEAD=%s\n" "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf "PI_DIRTY_COUNT=%s\n" "$(git status --porcelain=v1 | wc -l | tr -d " ")"
printf "PI_GIT_STATUS_BEGIN\n"
git status --short --branch
printf "PI_GIT_STATUS_END\n"
printf "PI_STORAGE\n"
df -h .
printf "PI_DATA_PRESENT=%s\n" "$(test -f backend/data/app.db && echo yes || echo no)"
printf "PI_DIST_PRESENT=%s\n" "$(test -f frontend/dist/index.html && echo yes || echo no)"
printf "PI_DB_SIZE_BYTES=%s\n" "$(test -f backend/data/app.db && stat -c %s backend/data/app.db || echo 0)"
printf "PI_SERVICE_STATUS_BEGIN\n"
make server-status
printf "PI_SERVICE_STATUS_END\n"
printf "PI_TUNNEL_STATUS_BEGIN\n"
make tunnel-status
printf "PI_TUNNEL_STATUS_END\n"
printf "PI_HTTP_HEALTH="
curl -fsS --max-time 8 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health
printf "\n"
printf "PI_FRONT_HTTP="
curl -sS --max-time 8 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8000/
'
echo PHOTOMAP_PI_READONLY_PREFLIGHT_DONE
